task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, try to go east. With that over with, try to go south. That done, lift the Canadian limited edition latchkey from the floor of the lounge. If you can get your hands on the Canadian limited edition latchkey, attempt to move north. Once you get through with that, move west. Once you accomplish that, insert the Canadian limited edition latchkey into the Canadian limited edition gate's lock to unlock it. Then, open the Canadian limited edition gate within the studio. And then, make an effort to go to the north. Then, take a trip north. That done, go to the north. If you can do that, retrieve the butterfly from the floor of the basement. Alright, thanks!
